# CMake integration

ToolkitBuild generates CMake files for dependencies after restore.

## Generate integration files

```bash
tbuild generate --config debug --toolchain windows-msvc-x64
```

Default output:

```text
.tbuild/generated/cmake/
```

## Include generated files

Use a guarded include so a missing restore step produces a clear error.

```cmake
set(TBUILD_DEPS_FILE "${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/.tbuild/generated/cmake/tbuild_deps.cmake")
if(NOT EXISTS "${TBUILD_DEPS_FILE}")
    message(FATAL_ERROR "ToolkitBuild dependencies were not generated. Run: tbuild restore && tbuild generate")
endif()
include("${TBUILD_DEPS_FILE}")
```

## Link dependencies

The generated integration exposes dependency artifacts based on the manifest. Link using the names generated by ToolkitBuild for your project.

```cmake
add_executable(app src/main.cpp)
target_link_libraries(app PRIVATE fmt)
```

## Regeneration rule

Run `tbuild generate` after:

- Adding or removing dependencies.
- Changing artifact declarations.
- Changing configuration or toolchain.
- Running `tbuild restore` after an update.
